label: Building the table
subgoals: Make one row per prime and one column per ON minterm
Mark each minterm that a prime contains
Count the marks in a column as the ways to cover that minterm

label: Essential primes
subgoals: Find columns with exactly one mark
Select the prime that marks each such column
Delete every column covered by the selected essential primes

label: The residual problem
subgoals: Count the ON minterms left after selecting the essentials
Look for new essentials in the reduced table
Recognize a cyclic core where every column has two or more marks
